confidence_notes: Medium confidence. Food and drink anchors come from search-result summaries of Numbeo and Expatistan Chiang Mai pages (November 2026 snapshots used as a proxy for July 2026) and a few city cost guides. These are crowd-sourced or modelled, so ranges are wide. Beer and cappuccino are tightly clustered across sources, and meal anchors sit at or slightly above Numbeo medians, but the two-person mid-range meal is less precise. Cocktail and wine glass are less certain: no restaurant per-glass wine price was found, so the wine glass follows the local beer relationship, and the cocktail is a judgement across bar guides. Baht converted at about 33.9 THB per USD, implied by Numbeo's paired figures. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation search or live listing check was made, and July low season argues for the lower end.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are Chiang Mai-specific rather than borrowed from another city. Accommodation is benchmarked holistically against mid-sized Thai and Southeast Asian tourism cities, with a loose sense check against Expatistan's Chiang Mai versus Hanoi cost comparison.
